verdict.rationale: Carta provides an official Claude/MCP integration (plugins for cap table, fund performance, portfolio financials) that lets LLMs answer natural-language questions and generate tear sheets/budgets/financial statements from Carta data, which constitutes AI-generated insight-surfacing from within the ecosystem. However, this is delivered via a third-party AI client (Claude) rather than native in-product AI features, and there's no evidence of in-app generative insights/suggestions surfaced directly in Carta's own UI. Missing for 10: native in-product AI insight/suggestion features (not just external LLM plugin access), independent hands-on validation of the MCP integration's usefulness.
